messages:
Maeve K.: Quick sync — from the inc-489 postmortem: can we confirm owners + due dates for the outstanding action items? I want a short status so we can close the RCA and roll the changes into next sprint.

Jon P.: I own the rollout checklist update (item 2). Targeting Tue EOD. adding PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/rollout-checklist/pull/412

Carlos R.: I picked up the canary rollback playbook edit (item 4). Will finish by Wednesday morning. Need Tina to sanity-check the alert thresholds.

Tina (SRE): @Carlos R. I can validate thresholds tomorrow 9:30am PT. Also noticed the metric names changed in prod — will add note to the ticket.

Ruth S.: Security review for PR #3421 (item 6) is still pending. I'm blocked on access to the customer repro logs — @Maeve K. can you confirm if support will share sanitized logs?

Maeve K.: Support confirmed they can share sanitized logs by EOD today. Ruth, I'll DM the contact.

Jon P.: Small heads-up — the rollout checklist PR has a lint failure in the Yanker CI job. Tagging @deploy-bot output below:
```
[CI] yankerlint: FAIL - trailing whitespace in scripts/deploy.sh:42
Command: ./tools/yanker --check
```
I'll fix in a follow-up commit tonight.

deploy-bot: yankerlint run on branch maeve/rollout-fixes: FAIL (see CI link) :x:

Carlos R.: Re: dependency map — I'm waiting on eng-ml to confirm model inference tests won't be impacted by the rollback. I'll ping them in the eng-ml channel after this.

Maeve K.: Summary so far:
- Jon P. -> rollout checklist update -> due 1767671320 (Tue EOD) :white_check_mark: (fixing lint)
- Carlos R. -> canary rollback playbook -> due 1767734520 (Wed AM) :white_check_mark: (needs Tina validation)
- Ruth S. -> security review + logs -> due 1767618720 (Mon EOD) :hourglass_flowing_sand: (logs promised EOD)
- Tina (SRE) -> alert threshold validation -> due 1767652320 (Tue AM) :eyes:

Maeve K.: Can people confirm these due timestamps or suggest changes? If no reply by EOD I'm going to mark the ticket actionable as-is and assign follow-ups.

Ruth S.: Confirming the Monday EOD target is fine — I'll proceed once I get the logs.

Tina (SRE): Confirmed for Tue AM. I'll post validation notes in the ticket.

Jon P.: Confirmed. If lint takes longer I'll update the ticket with a micro-delay but still aim for Tue.

Carlos R.: Confirmed. Also added a note: eng-ml verify needed before canary is turned on. I'll list the eng-ml owner in the ticket.

Maeve K.: Thanks all. One last thing — anyone blocking on PR reviews that we should ping specifically?

Ruth S.: @security-team please prioritize a quick look at #3421 once logs posted.

Jon P.: I'll ping infra-reviewers for the checklist PR after the lint fix.

Maeve K.: Great. I'll close the RCA once all actions show as assigned with due dates tomorrow morning during the async check. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident inc-489: RCA status changed -> Actions assigned (4/4) by Maeve K.

Maeve K.: (added) If anything slips, please flag here and we can either extend due or escalate to the oncall PTL.

Carlos R.: Noted. I'll update if eng-ml reply delays the canary plan.

(End of thread)
